package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

const MD = 998244353

func powMod(a, e int64) int64 {
	res := int64(1)
	a %= MD
	for e > 0 {
		if e&1 == 1 {
			res = res * a % MD
		}
		a = a * a % MD
		e >>= 1
	}
	return res
}

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()

	var n int
	var k int64
	fmt.Fscan(in, &n, &k)

	if k >= int64(n) {
		fmt.Fprintln(out, 0)
		return
	}

	c := n - int(k)

	// Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to 2n
	size := 2 * n
	ff := make([]int64, size)
	gg := make([]int64, size)

	f := int64(1)
	for i := 0; i < size; i++ {
		ff[i] = f
		gg[i] = powMod(f, MD-2)
		f = f * int64(i+1) % MD
	}

	// Binomial coefficient function
	C := func(nn, kk int) int64 {
		if kk < 0 || kk > nn {
			return 0
		}
		return ff[nn] * gg[kk] % MD * gg[nn-kk] % MD
	}

	ans := int64(0)
	for a := 1; a <= c; a++ {
		x := powMod(int64(a), int64(n)) * C(c, a) % MD
		if (c-a)%2 == 0 {
			ans += x
		} else {
			ans -= x
		}
	}

	ans %= MD
	if ans < 0 {
		ans += MD
	}

	ans = ans * C(n, c) % MD

	if k > 0 {
		ans = ans * 2 % MD
	}

	fmt.Fprintln(out, ans)
}
```
